items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: Jimmy Strong, he was up to our house crying because he hardly had fare to get back to Chicago.

ctx.x: Like Crawford Worthington (list) he went with Mills Blue Rhythm Band. And who else, somebody else was in that band.

Jimmy Strong, he was up to our house crying because he hardly had fare to get back to Chicago. And so many of them they didn't even have the fare back to Chicago. But Zutty was all set because when Louis cut out from Connie's Inn, Louis wanted Zutty out of that band.
When Louis cut out what did he do? Did he get, go with Louis Russel's band then?
